_note: Reference panchang for Ujjain (Drik Panchang, geoname-id 1253914 = Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh; page states 23°10′56″N 75°46′35″E, Asia/Kolkata). NOTE: geoname-id 1253237 suggested in the plan is Veraval, Gujarat, not Ujjain. All times are local IST (UTC+05:30): span ends are 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM', sunrise/sunset/rahuKaal are 'HH:MM' (24h) on the entry's date. Drik publishes minutes only (truncation/rounding convention unknown). Each tithi/nakshatra/yoga/karana list is every element Drik lists for that Hindu day (sunrise to next sunrise), in order; the last element is the one in force at the next sunrise. 'end' is the published 'upto' time; where Drik printed no end ('upto Full Night', or no 'upto' for the trailing element), the end was read from the first later day page that prints it, recorded in 'endSource'. Index schemes: tithi 1-30 (1-15 Shukla, 15=Purnima, 16-30 Krishna, 30=Amavasya; paksha taken from the element link slug); nakshatra 1-27 (1=Ashwini); yoga 1-27 (1=Vishkambha); karana 1-60 in half-tithi order (1=Kimstughna, Drik spelling 'Kinstughna'; 2-57 cycle Bava..Vishti; 58 Shakuni, 59 Chatushpada, 60 Nagava). Drik's own element codes matched these indices wherever present. 'name' is the name as published. amantaMasa drops Drik's ' (Adhik)' suffix (kept in amantaMasaPublished) and sets adhik. vikramSamvat is as published on the day page (Drik switches to 2083 on 2026-03-19, while the Amanta month is still Phalguna). choghadiyaDay lists the 8 daytime choghadiya names from the Drik choghadiya page. Tags: kshaya-tithi = Drik lists a tithi that begins and ends between this sunrise and the next (kshayaTithi); vriddhi-tithi = the tithi at sunrise also prevailed at the previous sunrise (previous day page shows it 'upto Full Night', see vriddhiEvidence). Collected 2026-10-25. lahiriAyanamshaPublished is the 'Lahiri Ayanamsha' value Drik prints on the day page (degrees); it runs ~0.011° above the plan's quadratic formula.
